summary: VRSN, DPZ and CARG lead on durable profitability: all three sit at or near the top of their sector on gross profitability and have operating cash flow well above net income. The menu is thin on clean 9/9 names (VRSN, FTDR, NYT, MSM, AAPL). Several sector labels are wrong for the business (DPZ, MSM, FAST, MSCI, MCO), so sector ranks and any sector-overlap arguments need caution; this follows lesson L3, which shaped the DPZ, MSM, MSCI and MCO calls below. The five holdings off the menu are all funds with no SEC metrics, so their absence tells us nothing about quality.
